entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That was careless of us. It should be no[n]surprise that a prison has guards.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait a sec... This is everyone's Palace,[n]right? Not like Kamoshida's castle...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hold on though. It wasn't open until we[n]came here today.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sorry... It's just a sense I'm getting.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Still... it feels like I'm really close to[n]remembering something important...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, comin' in here was what you[n]wanted from the beginning.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We just gotta keep movin' on!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: On top of that, I'm curious to know who[n]the ruler of this place is.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Leave them be. They'll be taken care of[n]if we erase Mementos.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey, it's dangerous to keep standing[n]around here! Let's get going!
